Subject: Lviv Debate Club: you are invited to be its head

Hello Olena Koval,

Oleksii Stroganov invites you to be the head of Lviv Debate Club in cab, where debate clubs run their sessions.

Open this link and sign in with GitHub or Google; you become the head as soon as you are signed in:

https://cab.uadebate.com/head-invitations/9fJ2...

The link works once and expires on 2026-10-26.
